spec.description: Rankings and aggregations across ALL games in the time range (default: today) on ANY host: top 5 boards for score, clean streak, finish-line time, overtakes, crashes, slowest crash, off-road rate and best score per stage reached, plus a route heat map. n = TOP_N in dashboards/generate.py.

spec.title: 🏆 Top 5: highest scores
spec.description: Highest final score per finished game, across all hosts in the time range.

spec.expr: (max by (session_label, player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.session.end" | unwrap final_score [$__range]))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_label", "~", "", ".*"), "player_initials", "~", "", ".*")

spec.expression: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.`__value__` DESC) AS `Rank`, A.player_initials AS Player, A.`__value__` AS `Score` FROM A WHERE A.session_label <> '~' ORDER BY A.`__value__` DESC LIMIT 5

spec.title: 🧼 Top 5: longest clean driving streak
spec.description: Longest stretch without a crash or off-road incident in a single game (wall-clock seconds).

spec.expr: (max by (session_label, player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.session.end" | unwrap longest_clean_seconds [$__range]))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_label", "~", "", ".*"), "player_initials", "~", "", ".*")

spec.expression: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.`__value__` DESC) AS `Rank`, A.player_initials AS Player, A.`__value__` AS `Streak` FROM A WHERE A.session_label <> '~' ORDER BY A.`__value__` DESC LIMIT 5

spec.title: ⏱️ Top 5: most time left at the finish
spec.description: Seconds left on the clock when the goal line was crossed (completed games only).

spec.expr: (max by (session_label, player_initials) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.gameover" | completed="1" | unwrap time_remaining_seconds [$__range]))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_label", "~", "", ".*"), "player_initials", "~", "", ".*")

spec.expression: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.`__value__` DESC) AS `Rank`, A.player_initials AS Player, A.`__value__` AS `Time left` FROM A WHERE A.session_label <> '~' ORDER BY A.`__value__` DESC LIMIT 5

spec.title: 🏁 Top 5 per stage reached: best score
spec.description: For each stage a game ENDED on (1-5; 5 = completed the course), the 5 best final scores.

spec.expr: (max by (session_label, player_initials, final_stage) (max_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.session.end" | unwrap final_score [$__range]))) or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_label", "~", "", ".*"), "player_initials", "~", "", ".*"), "final_stage", "~", "", ".*")

spec.expression: SELECT s.rn AS `Rank`, CONCAT('Stage ', s.final_stage) AS `Stage reached`, s.player_initials AS Player, s.`__value__` AS Score FROM (SELECT final_stage, player_initials, session_label, `__value__`, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY final_stage ORDER BY `__value__` DESC) AS rn FROM A WHERE session_label <> '~') s WHERE s.rn <= 5 ORDER BY s.final_stage ASC, s.rn ASC

spec.title: 🚗 Top 5: most vehicles overtaken
spec.description: Traffic overtakes (game.vehicle_overtake) in a single game.

spec.expression: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) DESC) AS `Rank`, A.player_initials AS Player, COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) AS `Overtakes` FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON A.session_label = B.session_label WHERE A.session_label <> '~' ORDER BY COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) DESC LIMIT 5

spec.title: 💥 Top 5: most crashes
spec.description: Crashes (game.crash: bump/spin/flip) in a single game.

spec.expression: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) DESC) AS `Rank`, A.player_initials AS Player, COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) AS `Crashes` FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON A.session_label = B.session_label WHERE A.session_label <> '~' ORDER BY COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) DESC LIMIT 5

spec.title: 🐢 Top 5: slowest crash
spec.description: Lowest speed (km/h) at which a game crashed — the gentlest crash per game, slowest first.

spec.expr: (min by (session_label, player_initials) (min_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.crash" | unwrap speed_kph [$__range]))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_label", "~", "", ".*"), "player_initials", "~", "", ".*")

spec.expression: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.`__value__` ASC) AS `Rank`, A.player_initials AS Player, A.`__value__` AS `Speed` FROM A WHERE A.session_label <> '~' ORDER BY A.`__value__` ASC LIMIT 5

spec.title: 🌿 Top 5: fewest off-road incidents
spec.description: Off-road incidents PER MINUTE DRIVEN (game.off_road count / summed stage durations), lowest first, so a long clean run beats a short one. Games driven for under 60s are excluded; ties go to the longer game. Zero-incident games are included.

spec.expr: (sum by (session_label) (sum_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.stage.end" | unwrap stage_duration_seconds [$__range]))) or label_replace(vector(0), "session_label", "~", "", ".*")

spec.expression: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) / (C.`__value__` / 60.0) ASC, C.`__value__` DESC) AS `Rank`, A.player_initials AS Player, COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) / (C.`__value__` / 60.0) AS `Per minute`, COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) AS `Off-road`, C.`__value__` / 60.0 AS `Minutes driven` FROM A LEFT JOIN B ON A.session_label = B.session_label JOIN C ON A.session_label = C.session_label WHERE A.session_label <> '~' AND C.`__value__` >= 60 ORDER BY COALESCE(B.`__value__`, 0) / (C.`__value__` / 60.0) ASC, C.`__value__` DESC LIMIT 5

spec.title: 🔥 Route heat map
spec.description: How many games used each stage and each leg of the course, across all hosts in the time range. Colour is relative to the busiest stage/leg: cool blue = rarely used -> red = most used. Grey = never used.

spec.expr: (sum by (session_label, stage_id) (count_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.stage.start" | session_label!="" [$__range]))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_label", "~", "", ".*"), "stage_id", "~", "", ".*")

spec.expression: SELECT stage_id, ROUND(100.0 * games / (SELECT MAX(games) FROM (SELECT stage_id, COUNT(DISTINCT session_label) AS games FROM A WHERE session_label <> '~' GROUP BY stage_id) m)) AS heat, games FROM (SELECT stage_id, COUNT(DISTINCT session_label) AS games FROM A WHERE session_label <> '~' GROUP BY stage_id) n

spec.title: 🔢 Route usage (games)
spec.description: Games per stage and per leg — the numbers behind the heat map colours, busiest first.

spec.expr: (sum by (session_label, stage_id) (count_over_time({service_name="cannonball-se"} | event="game.stage.start" | session_label!="" [$__range]))) or label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "session_label", "~", "", ".*"), "stage_id", "~", "", ".*")
